授業科目の概要.講義題目: Sustainable Aquaculture and Aquatic Food Systems
授業科目の概要.授業科目区分: 課題プロジェクト演習科目 Project research
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 生物資源環境科学府　Graduate School of Bioresource and Bioenvironment Sciences
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋期集中 その他 その他
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This is an intensive course taught in English. Students will work in groups to examine an aquaculture-related issue and present their findings and proposed solutions. Active participation in discussions and group activities is expected. The course schedule may be adjusted according to students’ progress.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
この授業では、養殖が世界の食料生産に果たす役割と、現在の養殖が抱える課題について学びます。飼料、魚病、水質、環境への影響、食品の安全性、加工など、さまざまな視点から養殖について考えます。
学生はグループに分かれ、関心のある課題を一つ選びます。文献や実際の事例を調べ、現在行われている対策とその問題点を整理し、改善案を発表します。この活動を通して、必要な情報を集めて考える力、グループで協力する力、英語で自分の考えを伝える力を身につけることを目指します。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course introduces the role of aquaculture in global food production and some of the main issues facing the sector. Topics include feed, fish health, disease, water quality, environmental impact, food safety, and processing.
Students will work in groups and select one aquaculture-related issue that interests them. They will examine published information and practical examples, discuss the strengths and limitations of current approaches, and suggest possible improvements. Through this work, students will practise finding and evaluating information, working with others, and presenting their ideas in English.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Aquaculture, aquatic foods, sustainability, fish health, food safety, environmental issues, problem-based learning
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Previous knowledge of aquaculture is not required. Students should be willing to read materials in English, take part in group discussions, share responsibility for the group project, and contribute to the final presentation.
